# Installation

Install `r pkg("seqpatch")` directly from GitHub using `BiocManager::install()`.
For typical RNA-seq workflows, we also recommend installing `r pkg("edgeR", "bioc")` and `r pkg("DESeq2", "bioc")`.
These packages provide methods for differentially expressed gene (DEG) testing and optional functions
used during DEGES-based normalization.


```{r installation-package, eval=FALSE}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(c("edgeR", "DESeq2", "bitdessin/seqpatch"))
```
